name: Farsen's Watch
summary: Near Gol'Bolar Quarry, Earthseer Farsen watches for Dark Iron movement close to Ironforge. The Wildhammer shaman lends you his farsight, revealing a threat that calls for swift action.

sections.title: Eyes Across the Ridge
sections.body: From his post above Gol'Bolar Quarry, Farsen watches the lower reaches of Dun Morogh. He came south from the crags of Aerie Peak, bringing a Wildhammer's spiritual awareness with him. His clan's old arts let him sense tremors underground and watch for sudden movement along the hillsides.

sections.title: A Borrowed Vision
sections.body: Farsen lends you his farsight, a shamanic gift that carries sight across great distances. Through it, you see danger beyond troggs and wild beasts. Dark Iron dwarves have drawn close to Ironforge's industrial center and are digging in. Their foothold must be confronted before it takes root.

faq.answer: Earthseer Farsen is a Wildhammer dwarf visiting Dun Morogh from Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands. His shamanic gift lets him sense disturbances in the land and watch threats from afar.

faq.q: Where is this watch taking place?
faq.answer: Farsen watches from above Gol'Bolar Quarry, a Bronzebeard mining excavation in eastern Dun Morogh.
Farsen's farsight reveals a nearby foothold of hostile Dark Iron dwarves, an active danger to the region.

faq.q: How does this connect to the Hall of Thanes?
faq.answer: Investigating the Dark Iron presence seen during Farsen's watch begins the chain of tasks for those seeking entry to the Hall of Thanes.

faq.q: Why is a Wildhammer dwarf involved in Dun Morogh's defense?
faq.answer: Wildhammers call the Hinterlands home, but kinship and their shared enmity toward the Dark Irons sometimes bring travelers like Farsen to the ancestral Bronzebeard lands of Dun Morogh.

faq.q: What comes directly after completing Farsen's Watch?
faq.answer: After you witness the Dark Iron infiltration through Farsen's vision, he urges you to suppress the encroaching enemy with 'Nip 'Em in the Bud'.

angles.text: As a Bronzebeard defender, you hear a warning from an Aerie Peak cousin. It shows how brazen the Dark Iron presence in your homeland has become.
As a shaman, you witness the earthen and spiritual vision of the Wildhammer tradition, rooted in the crags of Aerie Peak.
As an Alliance traveler, you help uncover Dark Iron plots in Dun Morogh and protect Ironforge and the surrounding mountain passes.
